note: Import from Flare Smart Accounts into memokit, via FSA payment-reference instruction 0x01. Live on Coston2 + XRPL Testnet. Run 1 of 2. This file was written after the fact, on 2026-09-23, from the chain: the script's own trace for this run was overwritten by run 2 and never committed. Every value below was re-read from the XRP Ledger or from Coston2 archive state, and each balance was read on two independent archive endpoints, which agreed.

source.why: the public Coston2 RPC has pruned this state (missing trie node), so balances at these blocks need an archive endpoint

otherAttestationRequests.note: Not ours. An attestation for the same XRPL payment, requested 4 blocks before ours. Ours was therefore redundant: it cost the 1000 wei fee and 83,304 gas and bought nothing. Run 2 shows the same pattern, so on the FSA import path memokit's own request has so far never been needed.

votingRoundSource: the proof's response.votingRound, read from the execute transaction's calldata
relayerNote: Renamed 2026-09-23 from 'relayedByFlareOperator'. relayedBy is an address; nothing on chain names who operates it, so the trace no longer labels it.
ourRelay: Never reached the chain. No transaction from 0x8848d857... to the FSA controller exists in blocks 35644912-35644947: the loss was caught before broadcast, so it cost no gas. PHASE3.md's 'reverted TransactionAlreadyExecuted' describes the simulated call, not a mined transaction.
latencyNote: The script's own stage marks for this run were not kept, so there is no submit-based latency. chainLatencySeconds below is measured from the XRPL ledger close, which is later than submit by several seconds; it is not directly comparable with the script-measured figures in other traces.
